standard_prerequisites.name: Smooth algebra retracts to a relative global complete intersection
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives C = R[x_1,...,x_n]/(f_1,...,f_c) smooth over R with retraction A -> C.

standard_prerequisites.name: Splitting of the conormal sequence of a smooth map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: short exact sequence of differentials of a smooth map (same chapter, structural)
standard_prerequisites.use: Omega_{C/R} projective splits the conormal sequence, producing the coefficients c_{ij}.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale maps are standard smooth
standard_prerequisites.use: Final step: rewrite the etale localization B_g as a standard smooth presentation.

core_obligations: Apply the syntomic-complete-intersection lemma: A -> C with retraction, C a relative global complete intersection.
Split the conormal sequence with a left inverse t of (f_1, ..., f_c) -> direct sum C dx_i; write t(dx_i) = sum c_{ij} f_j, giving sum_i (df_j/dx_i) c_{il} = delta_{jl}.

Set B' = C[y_1, ..., y_c] and consider the map R[z_1, ..., z_n] -> B', z_i -> x_i - sum_j c_{ij} y_j; a displayed computation shows the module of differentials of B' over R[z] vanishes modulo the ideal (y), so by Nakayama some g in 1 + (y) kills it and R[z] -> B'_g is unramified.

Fibre-wise: for every field k over R the map k[z] -> B'_g tensor k between smooth k-algebras of the same dimension is flat (CM over regular + geometrically regular fibres), hence R[z] -> B'_g is flat by the fibrewise flatness criterion, and then etale.
Write the etale algebra B'_g in standard smooth form by the etale-standard-smooth lemma; A -> B'_g is smooth with retraction since C -> B'_g is.
proof_roadmap: Retraction to a complete intersection; split conormal sequence; coordinate substitution; unramified-then-etale; standard smooth form.
difficulty_reason: A five-step argument; the substantive steps are the differential computation for the substitution and the fibrewise flatness conclusion, both carried explicitly.
